# data/external/

Unmodified external datasets (ERA5, NCEP/NCAR, optional cross-check). The `.nc`
files here are gitignored and reproducible via `make data`; what is tracked is
`MANIFEST.md` (full provenance), `checksums.sha256`, and the machine-readable
provenance records. ERA5 and NCEP/NCAR raw files are not redistributed through
this repository — re-download them under their own licence terms.
